skill.name: port-allocator
skill.description: Allocate and track local development server port ranges for projects so parallel AI coding sessions avoid conflicts.
skill.summary: Assigns predictable local port ranges to package.json projects and records them for repeat use.
skill.author: guo-yu

security_audit.summary: Most static backtick and entropy findings are false positives from Markdown formatting and localized text. Confirmed risks remain because the skill modifies hidden Claude configuration files, adds broad Bash allow permissions, and demonstrates lsof piped to xargs kill commands that can terminate local processes. No prompt-injection text or network exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.suggestion: Remove the /port-allocator allow workflow or replace it with narrow, per-command prompts. Do not allow Bash(cat ~/.claude/*) or other wildcard access to hidden Claude files.
Avoid writing to ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md from the skill. Show proposed text for manual user approval, or store only scoped port registry data.
Avoid kill -9 as the default guidance. Confirm the PID, command, and project ownership before terminating a process, and prefer graceful termination first.

content.value_statement: Local projects can collide when several AI coding sessions start development servers. This skill assigns predictable port ranges and records them for repeat use.
actual_capabilities: Detects projects that contain a package.json file under a configured code root.
Assigns 10-port ranges starting at port 3000 for each registered project.
Lists existing project port allocations for local development work.
Stores the code root and port registry in Claude configuration files.
Documents optional Claude Code permission settings for common local commands.
limitations: It is designed for projects that use package.json as the project marker.
It relies on local shell commands and hidden Claude configuration files.
It does not prove which application owns a process before kill commands run.
It does not manage ports for remote hosts or shared staging environments.

use_cases.title: Prevent Local Port Collisions
use_cases.description: Assign stable port ranges when several app projects run on the same workstation.

use_cases.title: Coordinate AI Coding Sessions
use_cases.description: Keep Claude Code or Codex sessions from choosing the same development server port.

use_cases.title: Audit Project Port Usage
use_cases.description: List registered projects and their assigned ranges before starting local services.

prompt_templates.title: Check Current Project
prompt_templates.prompt: Use /port-allocator to show the port range for the current project.

prompt_templates.title: List Registered Ports
prompt_templates.prompt: Use /port-allocator list and summarize the registered projects and port ranges.

prompt_templates.title: Scan Project Folder
prompt_templates.prompt: Use /port-allocator scan to find package.json projects under my configured code root.

prompt_templates.title: Configure Safely
prompt_templates.prompt: Use /port-allocator config ~/Code after confirming the folder exists. Ask before changing Claude permissions.

output_examples.input: Show the assigned ports for this project.
output: The current folder is a package project.
Use 3000 for the main app and 3001 for the API.

output_examples.input: Scan my code folder for new projects.
output: Scan complete for the configured code directory.
Existing projects kept their current ranges.
New package projects received the next available ranges.
Registered projects are shown with their assigned ranges.
Skipped folders are reported when they do not contain package.json.

best_practices: Review any Claude permission changes before applying them.
Set the code root to the smallest folder that contains your active projects.
Confirm a process belongs to the current project before terminating it.
anti_patterns: Do not grant broad wildcard access to hidden Claude files without review.
Do not kill all Node processes to free a single development port.
Do not overwrite global Claude instruction files during setup.

faq.question: What does this skill manage?
faq.answer: It manages local development port ranges for projects that contain package.json.

faq.question: Does it start development servers?
faq.answer: No. It documents port allocation and related local setup steps.

faq.question: Where does it store port data?
faq.answer: The instructions use a port registry file under the Claude configuration directory.

faq.question: Can it work with non-Node projects?
faq.answer: Only if those projects also include package.json or the instructions are adapted.

faq.question: Why should permissions be reviewed?
faq.answer: The skill suggests broad Bash permission patterns that can read hidden Claude files.

faq.question: Is it safe to kill processes with this skill?
faq.answer: Use caution. Confirm the port and process owner before terminating any local process.
